# ops_variable_set_project (Resource)

Applies a variable set to the workspaces of a project (not those linked to a repository).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ops_variable_set_project" "azure_prd" {
  variable_set_id = ops_variable_set.azure_prd.id
  project_id      = ops_project.prd.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)
- `variable_set_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <variable_set_id>/<project_id>.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ops_variable_set_project.azure_prd <variable_set_id>/<project_id>
```
